docs.summary: A named bus that audio is routed through on its way to the device, carrying a volume and a mute for everything feeding it.
docs.remarks: Groups live inside an [`AudioMixer`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Audio.AudioMixer) and are referenced by an [`OutputGroup`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.AudioSource~OutputGroup). Each one owns a native sound group whose output is attached to its parent's, so a volume set on a parent scales every descendant. The native side is built on demand and thrown away when the device closes, so the asset stays pure data.

docs.summary: Quietest volume, treated as silence rather than a very small gain.
Stable key this group is referenced by, independent of its name and position.
Level in decibels. 0 leaves audio unchanged, [`MinVolumeDB`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Audio.AudioMixerGroup~MinVolumeDB) is silence.
The same level as a 0 to 1 linear gain, for volume sliders.
Hears this bus on its own. Deliberately not saved: soloing is something you do while listening to a mix, not a property of it, and a project that opened with a bus soloed would be a mystery.
docs.remarks: While anything is soloed, a bus sounds only if it is the soloed one, is inside it, or is on the path it takes to the output. That last part is what makes soloing a child audible at all: every bus between it and the master has to keep passing audio.

docs.summary: True when a solo somewhere in this mixer is what is keeping this bus quiet.
True when `other` feeds into this bus, however far down.

Loudest sample this bus produced in the block it last processed, 0 when nothing is asking for levels. Ask through [`RequestMetering`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Audio.AudioMixerGroup~RequestMetering) for as long as you want it kept up to date.
Asks every bus to measure what it is producing. Call it each frame that meters are on screen.
docs.remarks: Off by default because it is a pass over every block of every bus, on the audio thread, for a number nobody is looking at. Asking expires on its own so a window that closes, or an editor that stops drawing, does not leave the work running.

docs.summary: The group this one feeds into, or null if it is the mixer's root.
The mixer this group belongs to. Resolved from the owning asset when this group was loaded on its own rather than as part of its mixer.
Effects applied to everything routed into this group, in order.
Adds an effect to this bus. The group owns it and destroys it when it is removed.
Removes an effect from this bus and destroys it.
Binds every effect to the current audio format and republishes the chain the audio thread reads. Call after editing [`Effects`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Audio.AudioMixerGroup~Effects) in place.

Frees native resources and anything derived from the payload. Runs when the asset unloads, before a refill and when a runtime asset is disposed. The database resets every field to its shell value afterwards.
Converts a decibel level to a linear gain, with [`MinVolumeDB`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Audio.AudioMixerGroup~MinVolumeDB) as silence.
Converts a linear gain to a decibel level, with 0 and below as [`MinVolumeDB`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Audio.AudioMixerGroup~MinVolumeDB).
